versions.liveHint: Opens in another tab. You can click the buttons and pick wallpapers there.

a: A thin top bar with the search in the middle. The monitors sit above “Apply”, in the right panel.
b: The right panel shows your monitors as they are arranged. Drag a wallpaper onto a monitor to apply it.
c: The bottom bar shows your monitors with their wallpaper, and you pick one there. The right panel is only for the wallpaper.
d: The wallpaper is shown inside the chosen monitor, with its real shape. You switch monitors below it.
e: More room for the library: picking a wallpaper opens a panel on top with the monitors and “Apply”.

intro.title: Help us choose how the {{brand}} app looks
intro.lead: {{brand}} is an animated wallpaper app for Windows and Linux. We have 5 versions of its window and we want to choose with your opinion.
intro.how: Look at the 5 versions (you can open them live) and answer 5 short steps, about 2 minutes. Only picking one is required. If you close the page, you'll pick up where you left off.
intro.edit: You already answered. You can change your answers: they replace the previous ones.

pick.title: Which one would you choose?
pick.lead: The one you'd use every day. If you're torn between two, the other one goes in the next step.

second.title: And your second choice?
second.lead: If the one you chose didn't exist. You can skip this step.

change.title: What would you change in version {{letter}}?
change.lead: What doesn't convince you, what's missing or what you'd move. You can leave it empty.
change.label: What you'd change

mix.title: Would you mix in something from another one?
mix.lead: For example, “the bottom bar from C”. You can skip this step.

ratings.title: Want to rate each version?
ratings.lead: Optional: a score from 1 (don't like it) to 5 (love it) for each one.
ratings.open: Yes, I want to rate them
ratings.skip: Otherwise, go on to “Review and send”.
ratings.label: Score for version {{letter}}

review.title: Review and send
review.lead: If something isn't how you wanted it, click “Change”.
review.name: Your name
review.nameHint: However you want us to know you: your name or your Discord nickname.
review.privacy: We store your name and your answers, nothing else: no email or IP. Only the {{brand}} team sees them.

done.title: Thank you, {{name}}!
done.text: Your opinion arrived. With the answers we'll choose the version (or the mix) and start building the app.
done.brand: Have you answered the logo survey yet?

errors.invalid_name: Write a name of 2 to 60 characters.
errors.invalid_answers: Some answer isn't valid. Reload the page and try again.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many submissions from your connection. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.not_found: We couldn't find your previous answer. Send it as a new one.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your internet and try again.
errors.generic: Couldn't send. Try again in a moment.
